title: Cosmic Eclipse Vision
description: A surreal symbolic scene features a giant cracked golden female bust with a black sun eclipse behind her head. To her left stands an armored warrior woman touching the bust's face, while a black silhouetted figure in a hat sits in the foreground among bones and flowers. A purple galaxy figure merges with the bust as a green staircase spirals into the starry sky.
